programs.title: Ancient Aliens
programs.desc: Around the world and throughout history, people have reported seeing very similar types of unidentified objects in the sky. Now, Ancient Aliens is counting down the top ten alien craft.

programs.title: World War II With Tom Hanks
programs.desc: After defeating Poland, Hitler looks west, planning an attack into France that will take advantage of a weak point in their defences. British Prime Minister Churchill scrambles to evacuate Allied troops.

programs.title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames
programs.desc: From epic ancient battles at Cannae and Agincourt to World War II's Battle of the Bulge and the Battle of Stalingrad, these are history's deadliest conflicts.

programs.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programs.sub_title: The Hunt For Cleopatra's Missing Tomb
programs.desc: She was the last pharaoh of Egypt and one of the most famous queens of all time, but her death in 31 B.C. has been shrouded in mystery. Cleopatra's body has been lost without a trace for over 2,000 years.

programs.title: World War II With Tom Hanks
programs.desc: In September 1939, enabled by a secret pact between Adolf Hitler and Josef Stalin, Germany invades Poland with its lightning style of tank warfare, plunging Europe back into war.

programs.title: The Unbelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programs.desc: From calling Veteran's Stadium home to setting up camp in an airport terminal to turning a dumpster into a luxurious abode. Each of these dwellings is so beyond odd that they are truly unbelievable.

programs.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programs.desc: Relics from the crucifixion of Jesus Christ have fascinated the faithful for 2000 years-from the wooden cross and iron nails to the crown of thorns. But do these sacred artefacts still exist.

programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.desc: A seller walks into the shop hoping to score with his Magic Johnson 50th birthday invitation. Is the deal a slam dunk? Then, Chum takes a look at some joker cards used as props in 'The Dark Knight'.

programs.title: The Pickers S26E392 -Pickin' Wall-To-Wall
programs.desc: Mike meets a Connecticut picker with major inventory-but getting access to his collection means dismantling a massive wall. Meanwhile, Robbie and Jersey comb through a collector's old-timey general store.

programs.title: The Toys That Built The World
programs.desc: In the 1970s, the board game industry is aimed almost entirely at children, until a literal game changer comes along in Trivial Pursuit. Redefining the possibilities for adult fun.

programs.title: The Food That Built The World
programs.desc: A Milwaukee company experiments with something new. What starts as an unappealing low-calorie beer becomes the number one beer in America, sparking a battle between two titans for the crown of light beer.

programs.title: Ride N' Seek: Quest For The Priestess' Cloak
programs.desc: Jaime makes way to the Philippines' Queen City of Cebu, where she conquers its roaring canyons, calms her nerves with some pythons, and harnesses her fighting skills in the country's first battleground.
